purpose: Pre-retirement baseline for Phase 40; every listed Today object remains read-only until the Phase 40.8 human gate.

home.current_semantics: SPA home currently boots the cover route; Phase 40 target is galaxy idle.
home.query_semantics: query is retained by buildHomePath and does not select a Today route

movie.current_semantics: positive known id focuses that movie; unknown id canonicalizes to home and cover boot.
movie.head_semantics: HEAD returns the GET status and headers with no body.
movie.accept_semantics: HTML injection accepts empty, text/html, or wildcard Accept excluding application/json; non-HTML Accept is 404.
movie.query_semantics: query is preserved in the canonical page URL and route builders.

today.current_semantics: Worker injects Today HTML metadata and SPA fallback serves the client cover route.
today.head_semantics: HEAD returns the GET status and headers with no body.
today.accept_semantics: HTML injection accepts empty, text/html, or wildcard Accept excluding application/json; non-HTML Accept is 404.
today.query_semantics: query is retained in Today og:url; trailing slash is accepted.
today.target_after_retirement: GET and HEAD return 404 for every Accept and query variant; no shell fetch or KV read.

today_og.head_semantics: HEAD returns the GET status and headers with no body.
today_og.accept_semantics: Accept does not alter PNG routing.
today_og.query_semantics: missing or stale v is replaced with the canonical v while unrelated query keys remain; canonical PNG is immutable.
today_og.target_after_retirement: GET and HEAD return 404 for every query variant; no brand fallback.

webgl_non_today_invariants: Idle macro fade blend is 1; selected focus blend is 0; select and deselect transitions interpolate between them.
Idle near and Z fades preserve their existing disabled and exempt behavior.
Normal movie focus keeps its focus emission, selection planet, and constellation-hidden behavior; idle keeps constellation visibility.

production_legacy_objects.current_contract: uploaded only when local today.json exists; public manifest URL has a date v query; cache-control public, max-age=3600, must-revalidate
optional fields emitted when today.json exists and consumed before the bundled Today URL fallback
JSON {date, movie_id}; current snapshot and Worker Today HTML/PNG depend on it
gzip JSON schema_version 1, projection_version og-index-v1, control today_value and meta_g_value; cache-control no-store
https://themoviecosmos.com/og/today.png?v={meta:G}-{today-content-hash}; layout version og-v1; canonical PNG cache is immutable
production_legacy_objects.delete_phase: 40.8 after Worker 404 release and cache cleanup

production_legacy_objects.current_contract: nightly 0 20 * * * UTC; monthly 0 20 1 * * UTC; both calculate Today, incrementally sync KV, then upload R2

rollback_boundary.before_v2_checkpoint_commit: Keep v1 checkpoint and KV today unchanged; rerun only the explicit migration after fixing the failed mutation or verification.
rollback_boundary.after_v2_checkpoint_commit_before_legacy: Rollback is permitted by retaining v1 R2 object and restoring the verified Worker/main releases; do not delete v1, today.json, KV today, or Today cache until the 40.8 audit passes.
rollback_boundary.after_legacy_cleanup: Requires a separately authorized recovery using recorded object metadata or backups; this fixture does not authorize recreation or remote mutation.
